themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Choose an available theme to preview and edit its CMS page content.

add.title: Add theme
add.description: Prepare a local theme for development or import it into the R2 theme bucket.
add.invalid: Enter an absolute path and a lowercase theme id using letters, numbers, and dashes.
add.source_help: Use the directory containing layout, sections, snippets, templates, and assets.
add.commands_description: The browser cannot read the path itself. Run the generated command from the plugin checkout.
add.local_description: Registers and links this theme, then watches all registered local themes while the Worker runs.
add.r2_description: Uploads the theme into the tenant-scoped THEMES bucket.
add.r2_secret_help: For a multi-tenant Worker, also set CMS_TENANT and the registered PLUGIN_SECRET.

editor.description: Preview a CMS page in the development theme, select a block, and edit its lect values.
